_about: Verifier test set. Every sentence is written as a note sentence about the simulated sessions in data/sessions. label 'ok' = the cited lines support it (a flag is a false alarm); any other label = a known error type the verifier should flag. Clinical error types beyond these are to be added by the clinical lead.

labels.contradiction: states the opposite of what was said (non-risk)
labels.speaker: therapist's words attributed to the client
labels.diagnosis: clinical label or diagnosis not made in the session
labels.citation: true elsewhere but cites the wrong line
